```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
pa <- read_csv("data/clean/PA.csv.gz") %>%
  filter(location_type == "county") %>%
  mutate(state = "PA")

fl <- read_csv("data/clean/FL.csv.gz") %>%
  filter(location_type == "county") %>%
  mutate(state = "FL")

or <- read_csv("data/clean/OR.csv.gz") %>%
  filter(location_type == "county") %>%
  mutate(state = "OR")

all_states <- bind_rows(pa, fl, or)

outcome_name <- "Cases Resulting in Conviction"

conv_all <- all_states %>%
  filter(
    measure_name == outcome_name,
    !is.na(value)
  )
```
```{r}
ggplot(conv_all, aes(x = state, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = paste0(outcome_name, " by State"),
    x = "State",
    y = "Conviction (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```

```{r}
county_conv <- all_states %>%
  filter(
    measure_name == "Cases Resulting in Conviction",
    !is.na(numerator),
    !is.na(denominator)
  ) %>%
  group_by(state, location_id, location_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_convictions = sum(numerator, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_cases = sum(denominator, na.rm = TRUE),
    conviction_rate = total_convictions / total_cases,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(county_conv, aes(x = state, y = conviction_rate)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "County-Level Conviction Rate by State",
    subtitle = "Normalized by total number of cases in each county",
    x = "State",
    y = "Conviction Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# 1. Load conviction data

pa <- read_csv("data/clean/PA.csv.gz") %>%
  filter(location_type == "county") %>%
  mutate(state = "PA")

fl <- read_csv("data/clean/FL.csv.gz") %>%
  filter(location_type == "county") %>%
  mutate(state = "FL")

or <- read_csv("data/clean/OR.csv.gz") %>%
  filter(location_type == "county") %>%
  mutate(state = "OR")

all_states <- bind_rows(pa, fl, or)

# 2. Aggregate conviction measure to county level

county_conv <- all_states %>%
  filter(
    measure_name == "Cases Resulting in Conviction",
    !is.na(numerator),
    !is.na(denominator)
  ) %>%
  group_by(state, location_id, location_name) %>%
  summarise(
    total_convictions = sum(numerator, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_cases_measure = sum(denominator, na.rm = TRUE),
    conviction_rate = total_convictions / total_cases_measure,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Load county characteristics

pa_char <- read_csv("data/combined/pa_characteristics_all.csv") %>%
  filter(location_type == "county") %>%
  mutate(state = "PA")

fl_char <- read_csv("data/combined/fl_characteristics_all.csv") %>%
  filter(location_type == "county") %>%
  mutate(state = "FL")

or_char <- read_csv("data/combined/or_characteristics_all.csv") %>%
  filter(location_type == "county") %>%
  mutate(state = "OR")

all_char <- bind_rows(pa_char, fl_char, or_char)

# 4. one row per county for characteristics

county_char <- all_char %>%
  group_by(state, location_id, location_name) %>%
  summarise(
    population = first(na.omit(population)),
    total_cases = first(na.omit(total_cases)),
    median_household_income = first(na.omit(median_household_income)),
    num_full_time_prosecutors = first(na.omit(num_full_time_prosecutors)),
    total_num_law_enforcement_agencies = first(na.omit(total_num_law_enforcement_agencies)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 5. Merge characteristics with conviction data

county_analysis <- county_conv %>%
  left_join(county_char, by = c("state", "location_id", "location_name"))

county_analysis <- county_analysis %>%
  mutate(convictions_per_10000 = (total_convictions / population) * 10000)

ggplot(county_analysis, aes(x = state, y = convictions_per_10000)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(
    title = "County Convictions per 10000 Residents by State",
    x = "State",
    y = "Convictions per 10000 Residents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
ggplot(county_analysis, aes(x = median_household_income, y = conviction_rate, color = state)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Conviction Rate vs Income by State",
    x = "Median Household Income",
    y = "Conviction Rate"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
```{r}
names(county_analysis)
```
